svg.title: How IBM Storage Ceph serves block, file and object
svg.desc: Three kinds of storage on one line, all served by one Storage Ceph cluster. Block: NVMe over TCP and Ceph RBD, including block access for VMware hosts. File: NFS, SMB and CephFS. Object: S3-compatible and Swift, with IAM, server-side encryption and Object Lock, replicated across locations, public clouds included.
